vector_source.paper: Salmon, Moraes, Dror, Shaw. Parallel Random Numbers: As Easy as 1, 2, 3. SC'11. doi:10.1145/2063384.2063405

determinism_receipt.workload: philox_counter_rng(seed, stream, counter) for stream in 0..streams, counter in 0..draws_per_stream, stream-major order; SHA-256 over the little-endian bytes of each u64 draw
determinism_receipt.cross_implementation_check: digest reproduced by an independent Python reimplementation validated against the same published vectors before being pinned here
determinism_receipt.note: Pure 32-bit integer arithmetic plus exact IEEE-754 mantissa fill; any conforming host (CPU-only, Metal-attached, CUDA-attached) recomputing this workload must reproduce this digest exactly. A mismatch is a determinism break in the seeded work-class substrate.
